item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R02-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R02-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R02-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R02-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R02-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In 2020, 2,591 protection orders were granted to women victims of violence and stalking, representing 84% of all granted protection orders (2,591 of 3,065).","notes":["The excerpt supports the figures and year, but does not directly state that German family courts granted the orders; it identifies family court statistics as the source."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R02-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"EIGE reported that police data were widely available on victims of intimate-partner violence, domestic violence, violence in any relationship, homicide, and rape. Justice-sector data were limited: data were retrieved only for 2020 protection orders, and no data were available on perpetrators prosecuted, sentenced, or held in prison.","notes":["The excerpt does not say that data on reported perpetrators were widely available; it says EIGE retrieved data on perpetrators reported for intimate-partner violence and that prosecution, sentencing, and imprisonment data were unavailable."]}]}
